decisions.title: Local offline first
decisions.statement: Client-side static offline-capable application; no remote backend, accounts or remote AI services.

decisions.title: IndexedDB supersedes localStorage-only
decisions.statement: Dexie IndexedDB is required; original no-database/localStorage-only condition is superseded for local persistence.

decisions.title: Preserve legacy records
decisions.statement: Migration must be atomic, idempotent and non-destructive; never delete legacy localStorage keys or overwrite newer Dexie IDs.

decisions.title: Exact manufacturing units
decisions.statement: Use integer millimetres; honour kerf, grain, rotation, stock count and edge annotations; never silently reinterpret final dimensions.

decisions.title: Optimiser is heuristic
decisions.statement: Validate every layout, do not claim globally optimal results.

decisions.title: 3D panel preview is nonauthoritative
decisions.statement: Exploded panel inventory is not a structurally validated assembly or cutting layout.

decisions.title: Fusion export is a snapshot
decisions.statement: Export Python direct-model solids, not live linked native Fusion .f3d or .step; in-Fusion execution unverified.

decisions.title: Typed component graph + specialist roots
decisions.statement: Reuse components and recipe-based generators; do not model every furniture family as a cabinet.

decisions.title: Single normalised furniture projection
decisions.statement: 3D, cut rows, BOM, Fusion outputs originate from consistent FurnitureModel; no fictitious manufacturing validity.

decisions.title: Real recipe maturity only
decisions.statement: 54 working recipes do not mean all planned mechanisms are implemented.

decisions.title: Repository and pages target
decisions.statement: Current target furniture-builder with Pages base /furniture-builder/; legacy references differ.

decisions.title: No native Claude Flow without pin
decisions.statement: Research did not verify installed/pinned Claude Flow/Ruflo version; version-neutral contracts only.
